desc: The Oversight subcommittee chaired by Glenn Grothman with Robert Garcia as ranking member that held the 26 July 2023 hearing - the founding document of the modern House UAP record. Grothman waived six non-members onto the subcommittee for the proceeding: Burchett, Luna, Gaetz, Burlison, Ocasio-Cortez and Ogles. That waiver list is itself a map of the disclosure caucus at its formation. The subcommittee co-hosted the 13 November 2024 joint hearing with Nancy Mace's Cybersecurity subcommittee. Its jurisdiction over national security within a committee that has government-wide investigative reach is what made it the only viable venue for a public UAP hearing in 2023: Armed Services and Intelligence had the clearances but no appetite, and Oversight had the appetite but not the clearances.
